# Alexandre Girard Davila

> Senior Software Engineer with over two decades of experience in full-stack development, specializing in open-source solutions and AI/ML integration. Award-winning developer (IK Prize 2016, Tate · Microsoft · Fabrica · Jolibrain) with expertise in computer vision, edge computing, and enterprise AI infrastructure. Active open-source contributor across network visualization, computer vision, and hardware integration.

## Projects

- [Colette](https://colette.chat): Production-ready self-hosted RAG and LLM serving platform for enterprise AI infrastructure
- [Recognition](https://github.com/jolibrain/recognition): IK Prize 2016 winner at Tate Britain — AI installation comparing photojournalism with British art collection, built with Microsoft and Fabrica
- [JoliGen](https://joligen.com): AI-powered generative art platform used by Cartier for luxury retail experiences
- [Parasol](https://github.com/alx/parasol): Network graph exploration tool for visualizing complex data relationships
- [React Bounding Box](https://github.com/alx/react-bounding-box): HTML Canvas library for displaying bounding boxes on images with React integration
- [DeepDetect JS](https://github.com/jolibrain/deepdetect-js): JavaScript client library for the DeepDetect deep learning server
